recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle urban photograph of a man in a black suit standing on a skyscraper ledge, overlaid with aggressive, thick white oil-paint lettering and expressive, multicolored impasto brushstrokes that partially obscure the subject and background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated into the background via digital paint overlays
Large-scale hand-drawn typography dominating the left and lower foreground
Contrast between the sharp photographic realism and the raw, tactile texture of the paint
Muted city palette versus vibrant, saturated paint accents
coreInvariants: Thick, visible bristle textures in the white lettering
Subject looking away from the camera toward the cityscape
Impasto paint smears in peach, teal, and blue

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male figure positioned in the right third, full-body shot from a low angle looking up, appearing small against the massive typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, central white brush-lettered word in the middle-left of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down through the large central word, follows the subject's gaze toward the right, and settles on the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky area is filled with atmospheric haze and paint textures to minimize empty space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated urban tones (grey, slate, muted blue) in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Opaque white used for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Peach, teal, and navy blue in the expressive paint strokes behind the subject.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white text pops against the mid-tone background; saturation is reserved strictly for the painterly digital overlays.
paletteRestrictions: No pure blacks in the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: All-caps sans-serif with varying widths and organic, uneven baselines.
letterConstructionRules: Simulated dry-brush effect with visible bristle streaks
Heavy impasto 'glob' effects at the start and end of strokes
Inconsistent letter heights and widths to mimic spontaneous graffiti
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'W' and 'A' feature exaggerated, elongated strokes that overlap other elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style execution with varying scale to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: To maintain the tactile, physical medium appearance.
For the urban, rebellious energy of the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a black suit stands on a skyscraper roof overlooking a foggy city. Apply digital oil paint strokes in peach and teal behind him, blending his silhouette into the sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a thick white oil-paint brush tool, hand-write the text in large, aggressive all-caps across the left and bottom of the image, ensuring bristle textures are visible.

verificationChecks: Text appears to be painted 'on top' of the lens or scene
Subject's suit remains the darkest point of the image

mustRedesign: Do not use existing band logos
Ensure text is legible despite the texture
postGenerationChecks: Is the white text sufficiently opaque?
Do the paint strokes feel integrated or just pasted on?
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban photography + Impasto paint overlays + Massive hand-brushed white display type.
